patterns: Bond casting arms race owns the board: Pattinson test (4.35M), 5-finalists poll (4.69M), Harry Styles talks (2.00M), mystery-actors tease (1.26M), Hoult add (457k).
Toy-to-screen trailer spike: LEGO Ninjago anime first trailer hits 6.27M — the single biggest original of the window.
Godzilla Minus Zero multi-angle stack: CinemaScore A (267k), Ghidorah look (837k), $30–33M tracking (87k), biggest-international-open claim (55k).
Greenlight / sequel news still prints: Disney Medusa + Rock producing (706k), 1408 sequel reunion (475k), GI Joe 2028 + Bradley Cooper (458k).
Classic BTS / anniversary clips steady mid-tier: Nightmare on Elm Street gimbal (41k), Matrix kung fu (22k), Starship Troopers 29th (27k), Alien Weaver test (8.6k).
Engagement bait formats: ‘who would you choose’ Bond poll + rating/intro prompts from ATRightMovies keep reply volume high even under 50k views.
narrative_synthesis: Bond casting ate the timeline overnight while a toy-anime trailer quietly took the crown: DiscussingFilm’s LEGO Ninjago first trailer leads at 6,267,319 views, then Bond stack (finalists poll 4.69M, Pattinson test 4.35M, Styles talks 2.00M). Secondary lanes: Godzilla Minus Zero CinemaScore A + BO tracking, Disney Medusa (Rock producing), 1408 sequel reunion, GI Joe 2028. Watchlist originals ≥5k views: 72 (RealEmirHan silent). Meta: casting polls + first-look/trailer still beat pure BO posts.
